title: Optimisation of quantification of phytohormones in tree crops by UHPLC-MS/MS
author: Sophie C. Jones
materials: Stock solutions of all deuterated and non-deuterated hormone internal standards should be prepared in 100% LC-MS grade methanol at a concentration of 100 ug/mL and stored in autosample vials at -80°C. Working solutions should be prepared by mixing 10 uL of 100 ug/mL stock with 990 uL 100% methanol to obtain 1 mL of 1 ug/mL solution.

Analyse raw data files using Analyst (SCIEX OS) software. Check that target ions are detected, and that the peaks are extracted correctly. Phytohormone levels in tested samples were determined based on the peak area ratios of endogenous tocorresponding ISTDs compounds calculated with the calibration curves of each standard.

steps.title: Prepare Internal Standard Mix
steps.instruction: Prepare an internal standard mix by pooling individual working solutions (1 µg/mL) of each phytohormone of interest to ensure 1 ng of each standard per sample.

steps.title: Homogenize Plant Tissue
steps.instruction: Finely grind the plant tissue of interest (freeze-dried or frozen under liquid nitrogen) using a homogeniser (e.g., TissueLyzer, GenoGrinder).

steps.title: Extract Tissue
steps.instruction: Extract 20-50 mg of homogenised tissue with 900 µL of extraction solvent containing 1% acetic acid, 100% acetonitrile and 5 µL of each internal standard (200 ng/mL), then vortex well.

steps.title: Perform QuEChERS Cleanup
steps.instruction: Add a dissolved QuEChERS mixture to each sample and vortex well.

substeps.instruction: Measure out 22.75 mg of QuEChERS mix per sample.
Dissolve the mix in 100 µL of 1% acetic acid and acetonitrile.
Add 100 µL of this dissolved mixture to each sample.

steps.title: Centrifuge and Evaporate
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the samples and evaporate the solvent to dryness.

substeps.instruction: Centrifuge at 4,500g for 5 minutes at room temperature.
Evaporate to dryness in a rotational vacuum concentrator (e.g., MiVac Quattro, GeneVac) for 3 hours or overnight.

steps.title: Re-dissolve Pellets
steps.instruction: Dissolve the dried pellets in 1 mL of 1% acetic acid.

steps.title: Prepare SPE Cartridge
steps.instruction: Prepare a C18 sep-pak cartridge using a vacuum SPE manifold (e.g., VM24, Phenomenex), ensuring the cartridge does not dry out during the process.

substeps.instruction: Wash the cartridge with 1 mL of 100% methanol.
Activate the cartridge with 1 mL of 1% acetic acid dissolved in MilliQ water.
Collect all flow products in a 15 mL falcon tube for discarding.

steps.title: Purify Samples via SPE
steps.instruction: Load samples onto the cartridge, wash, and elute.

substeps.instruction: Load the re-eluted samples from the previous dissolution step onto the cartridge.
Wash the column with 1 mL of 1% acetic acid dissolved in MilliQ water.
Change the flow-through tube rack to 2 mL tubes.
Elute the cartridge with 1 mL of 80% acetonitrile and 1% acetic acid.
Allow the cartridge to dry out for approximately 20-30 seconds after the volume has drained.

steps.title: Process Eluted Samples
steps.instruction: Handle the eluted samples based on the target hormones.

substeps.instruction: If proceeding with hormones that do not contain carboxyl groups (e.g., cytokinins), split the eluted sample (500 µL for cytokinins and 500 µL for derivatisation).

steps.title: Concentrate and Re-dissolve
steps.instruction: Evaporate the samples and re-dissolve for further processing.

substeps.instruction: Evaporate to dryness in a rotational vacuum concentrator (e.g., MiVac Quattro, GeneVac).
Dissolve the dried pellet with 30 µL of 1% acetic acid dissolved in MilliQ water.

steps.title: Derivatize Samples
steps.instruction: Perform derivatization on the dissolved samples.

substeps.instruction: Transfer dissolved samples into 200 µL microcentrifuge tubes and evaporate to dryness in a rotational vacuum concentrator (e.g., MiVac Quattro, GeneVac) for 1-2 hours.
Add 50 µL of 200 mM EDC solution in 100% ethanol to the dried sample.
Sonicate the samples for 1 minute at 40°C using an ultrasonic bath.
Incubate in a PCR machine at 40°C for 5 hours or overnight.
Evaporate to dryness in a rotational vacuum concentrator (e.g., MiVac Quattro, GeneVac).

steps.title: Final Sample Recovery
steps.instruction: Recover the derivatized samples and prepare for analysis.

substeps.instruction: Re-dissolve with 15 µL of 1% acetic acid dissolved in MilliQ water, centrifuge, and transfer to an autosample vial with a 100 µL insert.
Wash out with another 15 µL of 1% acetic acid dissolved in MilliQ water, centrifuge, and pool in the autosample vial.

steps.title: Prepare Non-Derivatized Samples
steps.instruction: Process samples that do not require derivatization.

substeps.instruction: Vortex re-suspended samples and centrifuge for 10 minutes at 4°C at top speed.
Transfer to an autosample vial with a 100 µL insert.
If non-derivatised samples were also extracted and transferred to an autosample vial, pool the derivatised sample with the non-derivatised sample.

steps.title: Store Samples
steps.instruction: Store samples at -80°C until the LC-MS run.

steps.title: Prepare Standard Curve
steps.instruction: Prepare and verify the internal standard mix for the standard curve.

substeps.instruction: Prepare internal standard mix at concentrations of 0, 0.1, 0.5, 1, 5, 10, and 20 ng/mL.
Analyse 1 µL of each internal standard concentration to ensure peaks are acceptable.

steps.title: Perform UHPLC-MS/MS Analysis
steps.instruction: Analyze 10 µL of sample using a Nevera X2 UHPLC system coupled with a 5500 triple quadrupole linear ion trap (QTRAP) MS system with ESI.

substeps.instruction: Set mobile phases: (A) 0.5% formic acid in MilliQ water (v/v) and (B) 0.5% formic acid in acetonitrile (v/v).
Use a 1.7 µm Kinetex C18 reversed phase UPLC column (Phenomenex).
Apply gradient: 95% B for 0.1 min, 95% to 4% B over 0.1 min, 4% B over 0.8 min, 4% to 15% B over 5 min, 15% to 95% over 3 min, 95% for 2 min, return to 4% over 0.1 min, then 1 min re-equilibration.
Set flow rate to 0.4 mL/min.
Set autosampler to 10°C and column compartment to 40°C.
Set MS parameters (positive ion mode): column temperature 45°C, curtain gas 20 psi, collision gas medium, ion source temperature 500°C, ion source gas 80 psi, spray voltage 4,500 V.
Acquire data in targeted positive ion monitoring mode using electrospray ionisation.
